entries.title: Node.js 27.0.0-alpha.0.1.1 (Alpha)
entries.content:
Antoine du Hamel

2026-11-16, Version 27.0.0-alpha.0.1.1 (Alpha), @aduh95

Notable Changes

  • [
    e0c71bcd1c
    ] - tools: notarize 
    bin/node
    in the darwin tarballs (Ulises Gascón) #67143

Commits

  • [
    aa0572bada
    ] - build: do not include vendored simdutf with 
    --shared-simdutf
    (Yao Zi) #67410
  • [
    a5672e8023
    ] - build: enable pie on linux (Chengzhong Wu) #67386
  • [
    cfb550171d
    ] - deps: V8: backport a05177279022 (René) #67416
  • [
    a92ee337b1
    ] - deps: update nghttp3 to 1.19.0 (Node.js GitHub Bot) #67333
  • [
    f775f92e2e
    ] - deps: V8: backport 2444c109f4f8 (Austin Burdine) #66736
  • [
    a4787636cb
    ] - deps: V8: cherry-pick 497c2e6a2434 (Dominik Inführ) #66728
  • [
    7c6dd81da3
    ] - doc: fix typo in releases.md (Ultron) #67463
  • [
    9fda0620f2
    ] - doc: add aduh95 as last security release stewards (Antoine du Hamel) #67434
  • [
    a23a18b8e5
    ] - doc: explain how sqlite binds numbers and BigInts (Trevor Burnham) #67424
  • [
    136ae6f518
    ] - doc: document invalid X509Certificate validity times (Sarthak Ahuja) #67406
  • [
    e396cb0bb3
    ] - doc: explain fallback arrays in package exports targets (Manjeet Singh) #67393
  • [
    3c930d22ea
    ] - doc: document 
    this
    binding in TLS callbacks (Robert I Nilsson) #66682
  • [
    1a1489838c
    ] - meta: update Trevor Burnham's email in 
    .mailmap
    (Trevor Burnham) #67425
  • [
    17be7f1efc
    ] - test: use relative paths within test directory in 
    test-watch-mode.mjs
    (Livia Medeiros) #67343
  • [
    5d51de3db7
    ] - test: deflake test-tls-resume-servername (Christian Aurich Zanettini Martins) #67450
  • [
    e3caf971c1
    ] - test: deflake test-fs-stat-cancel-inflight under FIPS (Christian Aurich Zanettini Martins) #67449
  • [
    098b4788ca
    ] - test: deflake test-watch-mode-files_watcher (Yuya Inoue) #67298
  • [
    b2f17a3732
    ] - test: deflake watch mode test for missing env file (Farid Zakaria) #67041
  • [
    5aac327abd
    ] - test: increase iterations on histogram test after snapshot changes (Stewart X Addison) #67379
  • [
    70d8236efe
    ] - tools: add support for multiple-commit PRs in 
    review_backport.sh
    (Antoine du Hamel) #67108
  • [
    e0c71bcd1c
    ] - tools: notarize bin/node in the darwin tarballs (Ulises Gascón) #67143
  • [
    67d57cfef1
    ] - tools: update mk-ca-bundle to 1.35 (René) #67403
  • [
    8dfdbb540e
    ] - tools: enable strict mode for yamllint (Antoine du Hamel) #67380
